info.description:
# DoFi Backend API

Covers JWT authentication, DoFI officer user management, company-scoped Fisherman role/user management, Jetty Manager public registration, Fisherman Flow B provisioning/claim login, officer Profiling, FINS Approval, Manifest, master reference data, and Dictionary endpoints.

## Flow B onboarding context

Fisherman and Jetty Manager onboarding are intentionally different:

- **Fisherman**: provision-before-login. QR + BruneiID resolves an eligible Fisherman account inside the Fisherman audience context. When no eligible Fisherman account is resolved for the verified IC, registration is never opened. Retired Fisherman public-registration endpoints and CompanyProfileContact auth fallback are not present in this collection.
- **Jetty Manager**: QR-first registration remains available. QR + BruneiID resolves an existing user with the system Jetty Manager role in the Jetty/admin resource context. When no Jetty Manager user exists, the existing `POST /api/v1/registrations/jetty_manager` flow may open, and that registration still enforces global normalized IC uniqueness.

QR identity resolution is audience-aware; create/provision/correction paths enforce the global IC invariant. `normalized_ic_number` is globally unique across all kept users. The same IC cannot be reused across Fisherman, Jetty Manager, another company, another platform, or another role.

## FINS Approval context

FINS Approval is the DoFI Officer governance module for Fisherman Owner/Admin users provisioned from Company Profiling, Jetty Manager registrations, and Approval Remarks used for reject/revoke reasons.

- Fisherman FINS includes only kept Company Profiling-provisioned system Owner/Admin users (`provisioning_source: dofi_company_profile`). Approval changes `fisherman_status` from `pending_approval` to `claimable`; QR + BruneiID claim is still required before access becomes `active`.
- Fisherman custom-role teammates created from Fisherman User Management start `claimable` and never enter FINS.
- Jetty Manager FINS includes kept users with the system Jetty Manager role and continues using `users.status`.
- Reject/deactivate/reactivate/revoke use separate permission codes and locked services. Revoke records revocation metadata; reject uses rejection audit/remark and does not populate `revoked_at`.

## Authentication flow

1. Run **Auth -> Sign In**. The test script saves the JWT to the `jwt_token` environment variable.
2. Officer/admin requests inherit collection-level Bearer auth (`{{jwt_token}}`).
3. Run **Auth -> BruneiID Login - Active** to save a seeded active Fisherman JWT to `fisherman_jwt_token` for Fisherman namespace requests.

## User Management and Owner/Admin governance

Fisherman companies have system-managed `Owner` and `Admin` roles. Owner is the company superadmin. Admin has high permissions but cannot govern Owner accounts. Fisherman User Management may manage custom-role users only. Owner/Admin provisioning and Owner governance belong to DoFI Company Profiling/FINS.

## Manifest module tokens

The **Manifest** folder needs officer and Fisherman identities in the same run. Officer Profiling/approval steps use `{{jwt_token}}`; Fisherman vessel/manifest actions use request-level Bearer tokens saved as `manifest_fisherman_jwt_token`, `manifest_commercial_fisherman_jwt_token`, and `manifest_skip_demo_jwt_token`.

## List endpoints

`GET` index endpoints accept Ransack query params (`q[...]`) and Pagy params (`page`, `limit`). See `docs/api/search-filter-sort-pagination.md`.

request.description: Authenticates with username/password and returns the JWT both as `data.access_token` in the JSON body and in the `Authorization` response header (`Bearer <token>`), plus the signed-in user's payload (including their role and full permission list). item.name: Companies - Vessels
item.description:
Officer/company-scoped CRUD for `CompaniesVessel`, nested under a `CompanyProfile` (`/api/v1/company_profiles/:company_profile_id/vessels`). A Fisherman can also self-serve these same endpoints for their own `company_profile_id` (see the "Vessels" folder further down, which uses the fisherman's own JWT) — Pundit scopes non-officers to `company_profile_id: user.company_profile_id`. Every vessel starts `approval_status: pending` (see Approvals - Vessels below), and any edit here automatically moves an `approved`/`amendment_required` vessel back to `pending` via `Approvable#revert_to_pending_for_edit!`, so an officer/fisherman editing already-reviewed data doesn't leave a stale approval on record. Requires `companies_vessels.*`.

For Small-Scale (Company/Full-Time/Part-Time) registration types, the fisherman-facing FE labels this resource "Boat" instead of "Vessel" and shows a reduced field set: `is_powered` (Powered/Non-Powered — gates whether `engine_count`/`horse_power` are shown, `length` always shows), `charter_type` (Own/Charter), and `boat_type` (Permanent/Temporary — gates whether `license_reg_date`/`license_expiry_date` are shown). Commercial keeps the full field set (`category`, `gross_tonnage`, `year_built`, `draft`, `material`); the backend accepts every field for every registration_type regardless of which fields that type's form actually shows.

Run "Create Profiling (Owner + Admin)" in the Profiling folder first so `company_profile_id` is set.
